surface_forms: une petite qui venait à mon cours

appraisal_events.evidence: Swann's eulogy (« un homme de premier ordre », « un homme délicieux, même fort joli garçon ») is immediately punctured by the catalogue of his charms: « ce qui peut suffire à constituer un ensemble rare et délicat, une barbe blonde et soyeuse, de jolis traits, une voix nasale, l'haleine forte et un œil de verre » ; Swann then calls the family « le type de la bourgeoisie réactionnaire, cléricale, à idées étroites », descended from a père Chenut who tipped coachmen a sou and ruined in the Union Générale krach.
appraisal_events.explanation: The dominant local movement is the deflation of the newly powerful M. Bontemps: the ironic list ending in bad breath and a glass eye cancels the praise it pretends to justify, and Swann's own account then reduces the family to narrow, reactionary, recently re-made bourgeois. The praise functions only as the setup for the puncture.

appraisal_events.evidence: « C'est l'oncle d'une petite qui venait à mon cours, dans une classe bien au-dessous de moi, la fameuse « Albertine ». Elle sera sûrement très « fast » mais en attendant elle a une drôle de touche. »
appraisal_events.explanation: Gilberte places Albertine socially and scholastically beneath herself and dismisses her as future-fast and oddly turned out; Swann's closing « Elle est étonnante ma fille, elle connaît tout le monde » ratifies his daughter's worldly command rather than defending the absent girl.

status_effects.explanation: Locally he ends up ridiculous rather than distinguished: the physical inventory and the family's reactionary, financially wrecked pedigree overwhelm the official titles just conferred on him.
She is introduced only as a lower-form schoolgirl with a vulgar future and an odd look, and no one in the scene contests that verdict.
She takes the judging position over Albertine with confident slang and is immediately admired by her father for knowing everyone.
The irony also lands on the enthusiast: his hyperbolic testimonial is voided within a sentence, and his eagerness to be explicit about a man he then despises exposes his appraisal as unreliable.

ambiguities: The deflating catalogue (« une voix nasale, l'haleine forte et un œil de verre ») is unattributed: it reads as narratorial commentary, but « ajoutait-il » in the next paragraph allows it to be Swann's own discourse rendered indirectly, which would make Swann the ironist rather than a secondary target of the irony.

The scare quotes in « la fameuse « Albertine » » carry a retrospective narratorial wink at a name that will matter enormously, which partly ironizes Gilberte's condescension without cancelling the local snub.
